name: Toi Ly Son
summary: Tỏi Lý Sơn is the island garlic Vietnam Airlines describes: small bulbs, even cloves, smooth white skin, a strong smell, and a mild heat. It also names single-clove garlic, black garlic, garlic wine, and garlic in honey.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the smell is strong and the heat is mild, not harsh.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines treats the bulb as a gift, and also names tỏi cô đơn, tỏi đen, rượu tỏi, and tỏi ngâm mật ong. It does not print a recipe for the raw bulb.
The young plant is the gỏi tỏi, which is a separate plate.
No city street and no hour were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Lý Sơn. Vietnam Airlines names no shop in Quảng Ngãi city.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 150,000–190,000 VND a kilogram.
seoDescription: Lý Sơn garlic, small bulbs with a mild heat. Vietnam Airlines prints 150,000–190,000 VND a kilogram. The hour is Check on arrival.
